Package co.edu.unbosque.model

Class EscuadraDTO

java.lang.Object
co.edu.unbosque.model.EscuadraDTO
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class EscuadraDTO extends Object implements Serializable
The EscuadraDTO class represents a squad in the cycling context. It contains information about the squad's name, race times, associated countries, and lists of cyclists, masseurs, and sports directors.
